name: education-center
description: Agent-first education operations for complex, human-centered work.
long_description: Education Operation Center is an agent-first Business Operating System organized around the education growth and enrollment funnel: Ads and Customer Outreach → Free Trial Class, Session, or Booking → Enrollment. It provides a collection of domain-specific skills, each with its own independent deterministic workflow. Intelligent orchestrators select and coordinate these skills to help authorized adult staff accomplish complex, human-centered tasks across marketing, lead follow-up, scheduling, trials, parent communications, enrollment, classes, camps, students, instructors, attribution, and reimbursement. Through a tenant-scoped BOS connection, each skill works with authorized data and connected services while preserving human judgment, approvals, organizational settings, roles, application scope, and provider boundaries.
default_prompts: Initialize my education center, including its customer-facing brand name.
Create today's education center operations plan.
Give me a weekly summary for my director.
